rule_a.clause_text: All attempts of cash deposits in amounts ranging from Rs. 9,00,000 to Rs. 9,99,999 conducted more than three times in a rolling 30-day period by the same customer or linked accounts shall be flagged as potential structuring and reported as STR.
rule_a.plain_english: Flags incoming cash transactions between ₹9 L and ₹10 L 3 or more times in the last 30 days.

rule_b.clause_text: All attempts of cash deposits in amounts ranging from Rs. 9,00,000 to Rs. 9,99,999 conducted more than three times in a rolling 30-day period by the same customer or linked accounts shall be flagged as potential structuring and reported as STR.
rule_b.plain_english: Flags incoming cash transactions between ₹13 L and ₹15 L 3 or more times in the last 30 days.
